task_spec.prompt: In the folder input/photos/, rename all .jpg files to the pattern 'YYYY-MM-DD_NNN.jpg' using each file's capture date (from EXIF), NNN a zero-padded sequence per day. Leave non-image files untouched.
core_assertions: primary: all jpgs renamed to the date pattern
primary: sequence numbering is correct per day
task_spec.setup: 待重命名的照片在 input/photos/(固定 5 张:IMG_0001/0002/0003.jpg、DSC_1010.jpg、photo (1).jpg)。起始素材由系统在 input/ 统一提供,请勿自建或更换文件——所有产品必须在同一份素材上跑,结果才可比。 就对这个文件夹这 5 张操作——文件夹位置和图片数量都固定,勿自建目录或增删图片。
